# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

[][28]
[][29]
[][30]

Left Right

### How Omega-3 Free Fatty Acids Improve Absorption

AvailOm^{®} from Evonik delivers EPA and DHA as free fatty acids in a solid omega-3 lysine complex,
the form that is absorbed most efficiently.
[Read Article][123]

### The Role of Potassium Iodide as a Dietary Supplement

Potassium iodide (KI) is one of the most widely used and bioavailable forms of iodine
supplementation, providing a safe and reliable source of iodine ions for a wide range of nutritional
applications.
[Read Article][124]

### Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ Laminating Adhesives

Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ laminating adhesives deliver fast cure, high line speeds, and
reliable performance for flexible packaging applications.
[Read Article][125]

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize
the use of the right lubricant for the operating conditions, material set, failure mode, and
maintenance interval.
[Read Article][126]

### What Is N,N-Dimethylacetoacetamide (DMAA)?

What is DMAA? Learn how N,N-dimethylacetoacetamide functions as a resin copromoter and chemical
intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.
[Read Article][127]

### Application Lab Testing for Camlin Fine Sciences Antioxidants

Camlin Fine Sciences (CFS) operates a dedicated Customer Application Lab staffed with technical
experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.
[Read Article][128]

### Eastman - Role of Triethyl Phosphate in PVC

Discover how triethyl phosphate enhances PVC flexibility and fire resistance as a co-plasticizer and
flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!
[Read Article][129]

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.
[Read Article][130]

[Hawkins Inc.]

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]

][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

into a single forecast you can act on.

  Predictions
  Forecast

  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

## Trusted by teams at

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity

  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads

  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast

  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

  move before it's made, not after the press release.

## Your team has ideas,

## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

HackMD is Markdown all the way down — authored, stored, versioned, and served. Humans stay in the
loop, agents get clean content without a translation layer.
[Illustration of two document cards labeled Problem and Acceptance Criteria.]

###### Your team writes

in a real-time editor with the formatting and structure you'd expect.
[Illustration of a document card with a sparkle mark, representing agents reading Markdown content.]

###### Your agents read

the same content, the same URLs, in the format they already understand.
[Illustration of document cards with checklist items, representing review and publishing control.]

###### You stay in control

of what gets reviewed, merged, published, or rolled back. Agents don't ship to production. Your team
does.
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Actions, OpenAI, and any tool that speaks Markdown.

A million-strong community of teams, researchers, hackers, and open-source contributors is using

[[Application introduction of Paints]][208]
[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

[more][234]
[[Pigment for textile printing]][235]
[Introduction of applications: Textiles][236]

Textile printing technology is based on a variety of ink resins as the carrier, composed of effect
pigments or dyes and related additives, with good adhesion. By different printing methods, words and
drawings are printed on textile fabrics.

[[Application introduction of Paints]][208]
[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

[more][234]
[[Pigment for textile printing]][235]
[Introduction of applications: Textiles][236]

Textile printing technology is based on a variety of ink resins as the carrier, composed of effect
pigments or dyes and related additives, with good adhesion. By different printing methods, words and
drawings are printed on textile fabrics.

Origin Water provides turnkey solution packages for remote camps providing piece of mind for the end

are backed by qualified service personal and 24/7 monitoring to ensure the plants provide years of
reliable trouble free operation,

business. The level of information explains why I had been told by colleagues to engage Origin Water
to help and review our systems on site and what could be done to ensure this critical operation of
STP and WTP are in correct working order at all times. *

*Origin Water will be used on many future mining projects to ensure sites are compliant, servicing
scheduling up to date, emergency call outs, refit and new STP and WTP systems for sites. *

Feature Overview

# Polymer library

[ Edit on GitHub ][138]

** The Polymer library is in maintenance mode. For new development, we recommend [Lit][139]. **

The Polymer library provides a set of features for creating custom elements. These features are
designed to make it easier and faster to make custom elements that work like standard DOM elements.
Similar to standard DOM elements, Polymer elements can be:
* Instantiated using a constructor or `document.createElement`.
* Configured using attributes or properties.
* Populated with internal DOM inside each instance.
* Responsive to property and attribute changes.
* Styled with internal defaults or externally.
* Responsive to methods that manipulate its internal state.

A basic Polymer element definition looks like this:

## Budujemy bezpieczeństwo dla zrównoważonego świata

Zwiększamy nasze zaangażowanie w rozwój zrównoważonego budownictwa. Uważnie śledzimy trendy i zmiany
w otaczającym nas świecie. Nieustannie pracujemy nad minimalizacją naszego wpływu na środowisko i
racjonalnym zarządzaniem zasobami. Jako spółka odpowiedzialna społecznie działamy na skalę
międzynarodową, tworząc bezpieczne miejsca pracy dla naszych pracowników.
[ Dowiedz się więcej ][33]

## Selena R&D – Badania i Rozwój

Tworzymy innowacyjne produkty zderzając nowoczesną naukę i potrzeby pracowników budowlanych. Nasze
laboratoria wyposażone są w wysokiej jakości sprzęt analityczny, co pozwala nam dogłębnie
analizować, testować i rozwijać produkty dla branży budowlanej. Łączymy technologie z różnych grup
produktowych tworząc nowe, nieznane dotychczas na rynku, rozwiązania.

## Budujemy bezpieczeństwo dla zrównoważonego świata

Zwiększamy nasze zaangażowanie w rozwój zrównoważonego budownictwa. Uważnie śledzimy trendy i zmiany
w otaczającym nas świecie. Nieustannie pracujemy nad minimalizacją naszego wpływu na środowisko i
racjonalnym zarządzaniem zasobami. Jako spółka odpowiedzialna społecznie działamy na skalę
międzynarodową, tworząc bezpieczne miejsca pracy dla naszych pracowników.
[ Dowiedz się więcej ][33]

## Selena R&D – Badania i Rozwój

Tworzymy innowacyjne produkty zderzając nowoczesną naukę i potrzeby pracowników budowlanych. Nasze
laboratoria wyposażone są w wysokiej jakości sprzęt analityczny, co pozwala nam dogłębnie
analizować, testować i rozwijać produkty dla branży budowlanej. Łączymy technologie z różnych grup
produktowych tworząc nowe, nieznane dotychczas na rynku, rozwiązania.

### UNDERWATER
### REPAIR & COATING SYSTEMS

][73][All products in this range can be applied and cured effectively in submerged conditions,

range for all your manual, mechanical and hydro-blasted surfaces.
][74]

### RUBBER
### (ELASTOMERIC) REPAIR SYSTEMS

][76][We’ve designed unique elastomeric repair products based on advanced two-component solvent-free
urethane polymers. Our rubber repair products are used across all industries, and you can apply them
by brush, roller or trowel, depending on your preferences.  
][77]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Composite Wrapping systems (GPR)]][78][

### COMPOSITE WRAPPING SYSTEMS (GRP)

][79][Our composite wrapping is a versatile and cost-effective way of repairing and preventing any
leaks or pinholes you might have in your pipes. This system goes beyond composite wrap pipeline
repair and can be used on wood, plastic, metal, and concrete.
][80]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Emergency pipe repair systems ]][81][

### EMERGENCY PIPE
### REPAIR SYSTEMS

][82][Need a quick but durable fix? Our emergency pipe repair technology provides a seal for leaks
in under three minutes. Products in this range have a high-pressure resistance capability, so are
suitable for emergency pipe repair across all industries.
][83]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Thistlebond Marine & Pipe repairs kits ]][84][

### THISTLEBOND MARINE & PIPE REPAIR KITS

][85][ThistleBond resin and hardener are made from liquid epoxide, creating the perfect adhesive for
repairing a wide range of materials. Alongside ThistleBond Resin, this product range includes Glass
Tape, Sealer Filler, A&B Cement, and more.
][86]

### CHEMICAL & CORROSION PROTECTIVE COATINGS

out our chemical and corrosion protective coatings. All our protective coatings are easy to use and
can be applied to both metallic and cementitious surfaces.
][89]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Concrete repair & Screed systems ]][90][

### CONCRETE REPAIR
### & SCREED SYSTEMS

][91][Our range of concrete and screed repair systems can fix cement or concrete cracks and are
ideal for concrete floor repair. These products include fast-curing and lightweight screed repair
materials to ensure you have optimum levels of adhesion.

][92]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Waterproof membranes & pipe coating ]][93][

### WATERPROOFING MEMBRANES
### & PIPE COATING

][94][If you need your pipes to have longevity, our range of single-component waterproofing
membranes can seal any surface. Choose from solvent-free epoxy, acrylic coatings, and water-based
acrylic waterproof membrane paint to satisfy all your sealant needs.
][95]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Unique roofing solutions ]][96][

### centaur ROOFING SOLUTIONS

][97][We are proud to announce our exciting partnership with Centaur Roofing. With Centaur's proven
systems and UPS’s extensive industry experience, we are committed to delivering tailored solutions
that not only meet your needs but also exceed your expectations.][98]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - PROTECTIVE FLOOR COATINGS]][99][

### PROTECTIVE FLOOR COATINGS

][100][Our solvent-free epoxy resin-based coatings are purpose-built to resurface and repair
concrete surfaces. These products feature self-levelling epoxy screeds for your ease of use and
provide a slip-resistant chemical protective finish.
][101]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Thermic coatings]][102][

### THERMIC COATINGS

][103][Based on a combination of innovative fillers and epoxy resin, our thermic coatings are
designed to minimise heat transfer from metallic surfaces, reduce your risk of contact burns, and
protect your equipment from corrosion and condensation.
][104]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Primer Products]][105][

### PRIMER products

][106][Our specialist primers are engineered to coat a range of cementitious surfaces, including
damp, porous, and newly laid cement. Fast-curing and solvent-free, you can coat these primers with
any of the protective coatings from the UPS range.
][107]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - Thistlebond Products ]][108][

][109][Our ThistleBond emergency repair and general maintenance products provide cost-effective
repair methods for engineers in a range of industries – both afloat and ashore. UPS is the only
official worldwide supplier of ThistleBond products.
][110]
[[UNIQUE POLYMER SYSTEMS - mini blaster ]][111][

][112][The most efficient way to remove scale, corrosion, filler, and aged coatings. You can use our
UPS Mini-Blaster on an array of surfaces to both clean and prepare them for the application of our
range of linings, coatings, elastomer repairs, and more.
